"YOU" (the direct second-person address to the player) always takes a plural verb (are/have), never "is/has" -- this is a subject-verb agreement error, not a style register, and the same class of defect the calibration adjudication itself already corrected elsewhere ("Why is YOU" -> "Why are YOU", U13-010 q7). It is shared briefing text every linked question depends on.
